survey: Two orange flip-flops lie side by side on a flat surface, seen from above at a three-quarter angle, toe ends toward the lower left. Each sole is a thick slab. Its top face shows as a foreshortened oval, and its thickness shows along the near (lower/left) edge, the same on both soles. The yellow V-strap rises from a toe post set into the sole near the toe end and runs back to two side anchor holes near the middle of the sole. The arms of the strap arch up off the sole, and the post reaches the sole at the right angle. The textured dots near the toe sit in rows that follow the sole's curved outline and shrink slightly toward the far side. Both sandals are drawn from one viewpoint and point the same way. The flat striped background gives no conflicting ground plane, and each soft shadow sits directly under its sole.
